top_headlines.headline: Elon Musk Shows Detailed Design of AI Data Center Satellite
top_headlines.summary: Musk's revelation of a joint SpaceX-Tesla 'Terafab' chip manufacturing facility directly links Tesla to SpaceX's orbital AI data center ambitions, providing a new hardware manufacturing catalyst for Tesla's AI narrative.

top_headlines.headline: Why Elon Musk's track record of unfilled promises matters for investors
top_headlines.summary: NYT analysis showing Musk delivered only 19% of stated goals on time directly challenges the credibility premium embedded in TSLA's AI/autonomy valuation, with specific skepticism directed at FSD and Cybercab timeline reliability.

top_headlines.headline: Tesla Stock Falls as SpaceX IPO Buzz Sparks Capital Rotation Fears
top_headlines.summary: Tesla fell 4% to ~$394 on a confluence of SpaceX capital rotation risk, Roadster delay to August, Barclays hold at $360 citing input cost headwinds, and broad Nasdaq weakness on rate hike fears.

top_headlines.headline: SpaceX IPO Turns Tesla Merger Talk Into a Core Wall Street Thesis
top_headlines.summary: Wolfe Research documents Tesla/SpaceX merger speculation has become a primary institutional TSLA thesis, with $150B in SpaceX IPO demand providing structural support for TSLA as the main Musk-franchise proxy.

top_headlines.headline: Tesla Stock Is Up. Cathie Wood Takes Us on a Robo-Taxi Ride.
top_headlines.summary: Tesla stock rose as Cathie Wood's public robotaxi ride and positive Dutch safety data signal potential regulatory opening for FSD in the European market.

top_headlines.headline: Tesla Gets 227.6% Target Boost As JPMorgan Upgrades Rating
top_headlines.summary: JPMorgan's 227.6% price target increase to $475 and shift to Neutral reflects a fundamental re-rating of Tesla's AI/robotics/autonomy opportunity across five $3.9T addressable markets.

top_headlines.headline: JP Morgan Triples Tesla's Price Target
top_headlines.summary: JPMorgan's $475 target with Tesla valued across five segments—auto, energy, robotaxis, humanoid robots, licensing—signals a fundamental re-rating rather than a tactical call.

top_headlines.headline: J.P. Morgan ends bearish Tesla call that was predicting a 65% stock drop
top_headlines.summary: JPMorgan lifted Tesla to Neutral from Underweight and raised its price target from $145 to $475, ending one of Wall Street's most vocal bearish calls.

top_headlines.headline: Tesla upgraded, Lululemon downgraded: Wall Street's top analyst calls
top_headlines.summary: JPMorgan upgraded Tesla to Neutral citing it as at the 'forefront of physical AI' with a $475 price target, up from $145; Erste Group also upgraded Tesla to Hold.

top_headlines.headline: Tesla just delivered one of its strongest China updates in months
top_headlines.summary: Tesla's Shanghai plant delivered 85,982 vehicles in May, up 39.4% YoY, beating the broader China EV market's 12% growth and signaling demand recovery.
